_readme: Agency recipients. The auto-sender ONLY emails addresses with verified=true. To verify: open source_url, confirm the address is listed for public complaints, set verified=true and verified_on. Found by web search on 2026-11-01; the official pages could not be opened from the build session.

CPCB.role: Central intake for air pollution complaints (forwards to the responsible agency)

DPCC.role: Delhi Pollution Control Committee: industry, construction dust
DPCC.note: Listed as Chairman, all matters of DPCC. No dedicated air-complaint address found.

MCD.role: Municipal Corporation of Delhi: open garbage/biomass burning, road dust
MCD.note: No official complaint email confirmed. commissioner@mcdonline.gov.in appears only in an NGT filing. Until verified, MCD items go to the CPCB intake.

Delhi Traffic Police.note: Site lists jtcpt-dtp@nic.in, addlcpt-dtp@nic.in, dcpthq-dtp@nic.in for traffic complaints/suggestions (per search result).
